newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on Guess? Inc Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on Guess? Inc Nov 15.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Friday it would list options on Guess? Inc on November 15.
The options will trade with introductory expirations in December, January, February and May. Opening strike prices will be at 10, 12-1/2 and 15.
Guess? shares were up 1/8 at 12-3/8 late morning Friday.
The options will trade in the EMC Corp crowd.
Guess? designs, markets, distributes and licenses casual apparel and accessories. -Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com
